chapters.title: Chapter 1: Death Of A Simp!
paragraphs: "Stan, let’s break up!" A girl with black hair said with her arms over her chest, her face full of disdain, her gaze cold, as if the guy in front of her were nothing but a stranger.
Stan’s heart skipped a beat. He hurriedly grabbed Lily’s hand and asked, "What’s wrong? Did I do something wrong? Why do you want to break up?"
"If I did something wrong, tell me, and I can change."

Lily was Stan’s goddess. He had chased her for three full years, acting as a simp by her side for three years. He had been blinded by love, or maybe infatuation, the thing is even he didn’t know that his action which he thinks is him being nice to her as a boyfriend was simply him simping over her.
He had only managed to win her over a week ago, so Lily’s sudden demand for a breakup caught him off guard.

"I only agreed to be your girlfriend because I had a fight with Leo and wanted to use you as a shield. Now that I’ve reconciled with Leo, don’t appear near me again. I’m worried Leo might misunderstand." Lily said in a cold voice.
In truth, she only used Stan Harrison as a tool and never truly liked him. The only reason she agreed to be his girlfriend was to use him to deliberately provoke Leo after their fight.
Stan said agitatedly, "Leo is just a scumbag! He’s dated so many girls. He only wants to play with you!"

"Shut up! Don’t insult my boyfriend. You aren’t even worth a finger of his! You’re just a loser. Do you know how embarrassing it was to be with you? I couldn’t even hold my head up in front of my best friends. Get lost!"
With that, Lily turned and got into the Mercedes-Benz parked in the distance, leaving.

’They never like the good ones, if after all I’ve done for her, she can still dump me so easily, I guess we were never meant to stay together...’ Stan sighed, but still he clenched his fists tightly, feeling incredibly unwilling to accept this.
Three years. Three whole years.
Stan had acted as a simp by Lily’s side for three years. If Lily said she was hungry, no matter what Stan was doing, he would squeeze out the time to deliver food to her.
He had given everything for Lily, even preferring to go hungry himself just to save money to buy her bags, only to be met with heartless ridicule in return.
"Another loser got dumped?"
"Why date if you don’t have money? Getting dumped serves him right."
"Isn’t that the simp Stan? I heard he scrimped and saved, delivering food on Sundays to make money, saving up for a whole year just to buy Lily a designer bag. What a joke."
"Stan chased Lily for three whole years, yet Leo took her down in just three days."
"As expected. Poor people don’t deserve to date."
The onlookers around them all cast disdainful looks at Stan, it was really embarrassing. Only now did it dawn on stan how much of a simp he was acting just because he wanted to bag Lily

Stan returned to the dormitory in low spirits, gritting his teeth as he coldly snorted, "I, Stan Harrison, will never be a simp again in this life. From now on, I will stand tall and live with dignity."
Summing up everything that happened over these three years, there was one lesson learned.
A simp ends up with nothing. He had already come to terms with the fact that he’s a simp. At this point he swore inwardly that he won’t help anyone unless there’s a worthy benefit in store for him.
It might take long, but after realising how much he had lost, he decided this was the best time to focus on himself.
[Ding!]
[Supreme Rebate System activated. Loading... 10%... 40%... 70%... 100%.]
[Supreme Rebate System loaded successfully.]
[This System focuses on Double Rebate]
This was a bit sudden, Stan being knowledgeable about such stuff was actually very shocked... It took him a few seconds to come in terms with the fact that he just randomly awakened a system...
’Is this... a cheat code?’
Stan was pleasantly surprised. He had read web novels, so he knew a little bit about systems.
He never expected such a stroke of luck to fall on him.
"What is a double rebate?" Stan Harrison asked, puzzled.
[The host can bind with women with a beauty score of 8.5 or higher and make them the target of consumption. Spending money on the bound target will grant a double rebate.]
[50 favorability points grant a double rebate, over 50 favorability points grant a 5x rebate, and over 100 favorability points grant a 10x rebate.]
"Really? A double rebate?"
"If I spend 100 dollars, doesn’t that mean I get 200 back?"
Stan Harrison was excited and wanted to test if what the system said was true.
Stan Harrison wandered around the campus, but he couldn’t find any beauties with a beauty score of 8.5. Most of them were only a 7 or 7.5.
Over thirty minutes passed, and he hadn’t found a single beauty with a score of 8.5.
He figured the sun was too harsh, and the beauties didn’t want to come out.
Suddenly, a flash of inspiration hit Stan Harrison.
"Can I bind with a beauty with a score of 8 or higher who is a streamer as a consumption target?" Stan asked the system
While it pained him that he has to utilise girls since he planned to focus on himself, it’d not only be a waste but it’ll also be outrightly dumb if he doesn’t utilise this cheat of his.
Anyways the system replied, it’s voice echoing in Stan’s mind...
[You can bind consumption targets. Note: You can only bind two women per day.]
Stan Harrison opened tiktuk Live Stream app.

He entered the beauty section to start picking a woman. Although the beauties in the beauty section were all very pretty, they all used beauty filters. Most were 7.8, and he couldn’t find anyone with a score of 8.5.
Stan Harrison browsed around casually and saw Maya Zimmerman streaming.
Maya Zimmerman was the second-ranked campus belle at Peak University, and her beauty was even beyond Lily Xavier’s.
Although Maya was very beautiful and had been streaming for a long time, she lacked resources and connections, so her stream only had a popularity of 100,000.
[Maya Zimmerman: Beauty score 8.8. Can bind as a consumption target.]
[Do you want to bind this target?]
[Y/N]
"Bind."
[Binding successful. Reward: 10 million.]
[Maya Zimmerman: Favorability 0.]
[Note: Reach 50 favorability to get a 5x consumption rebate. Please work hard to increase favorability, host.]
[Ding!]
Stan Harrison received a text message: "Your US Construction Bank card has received 10,000,000 dollars."
Seeing this astonishing eight-digit figure, Stan Harrison was so excited he almost couldn’t catch his breath.
The system was real indeed. He was rich now.
’Calm down, calm down. 10 million isn’t my goal. My goal is 10 billion. No, why settle for that when I can even go higher, the prospects of this is unimaginable’
People were gifting in Maya’s stream, but most were small gifts worth a dime or two.
Some people sent gifts worth a few dollars or tens of dollars, but those were rare.
Stan Harrison started topping up his account. The maximum top-up was 688 each time, so he had to click over and over. Stan Harrison clicked for a full thirty minutes until his hand started to ache.
Maya Zimmerman was doing a PK live stream with a female streamer named Xiao Rourou.
The opponent was an internet celebrity streamer with 600,000 followers, while Maya had less than 100,000. There was a huge disparity between the two.
"Everyone, don’t bother gifting. We probably won’t win the PK."
Maya had almost given up resistance. The opponent was a streamer with 600,000 followers; Maya Zimmerman couldn’t compete.
As expected, after the PK started, Maya Zimmerman was constantly being suppressed by the opponent.
It was time for Stan Harrison to perform. Without a word, he immediately sent a Super Rocket.
[User [A Streak of Green on the Head] gifted the streamer Super Rocket x1.]
A rocket slowly drifted across the screen.
The entire stream was covered in dazzling special effects.
It wasn’t just Maya Zimmerman’s stream; all users watching the live stream could see the rocket effect.
GrandmaWithAShotgun: [Holy crap... Sending a rocket without a word. Are you not going to live next month?]
EmotionalDamageDealer: [Are you going to be eating dirt next month?]
MainCharacterDelusion: [Genuine question... How much does one has to have to spend this much on a girl’s live stream?]
The stream, which hadn’t been very lively, instantly boiled over. But none of them where prepared for what was coming next..
SUPER ROCKET X10
SUPER ROCKET X20
SUPER ROCKET X30
SirYeetsALot: [Damn. A big shot has arrived.]
Where did this rich guy come from?]
PlotArmorExpired: [Rich guy, do you need a sidekick?]
I’mNotAD*mbass: [Bro 😭 send just 1000$ to my account and I’ll genuinely lick your ass every day]
1HPAndCrying: [@I’mNotAD*mbass ew bro eww 🤢]
And the gifts kept coming.
SUPER ROCKET X40
SUPER ROCKET X50
On the tiktuk live stream platform, endless rockets began to drift across the public chat screens of every single stream.
Maya was so excited she didn’t know what to do. She had thought she was done for in this PK.
She never expected a big shot to appear in her stream.
Stan Harrison, in front of his phone, was expressionless, gifting frantically like a heartless robot, as if the rockets he was sending were free.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: How?!
paragraphs: With double cashback, Stan Harrison didn’t feel the pinch at all; he was only worried that he wasn’t spending enough money.
"Thank you to A Streak of Green on the Head for the Super Rocket, thank you!"
"Thank you to A Streak of Green on the Head for the sixty Super Rockets, thank you, Brother."
"Brother, do you like watching people dance? How about I dance for you?"
Just as Stan Harrison was about to stop gifting inorder to reply to the streamer, he received a warning from the system.
[Reminder to the host: if you stop gifting, it will count as one consumption cashback. You can only have two consumption cashbacks per week. Please be cautious, host.]
Stan Harrison continued to send gifts, not daring to stop at all, not even having the chance to reply.
The gift spamming in the live stream room never stopped.
SUPER ROCKET × 60
SUPER ROCKET × 100
SUPER ROCKET × 600
SUPER ROCKET × 999
One Super Rocket costs two thousand dollars; ten Super Rockets would be twenty thousand, and one hundred Super Rockets would be two hundred thousand.
In less than thirty minutes, Stan Harrison had already spent a full million dollars on gifts.
Maya Zimmerman had clearly never encountered this situation before and, for a moment, didn’t know what to do.
PancakeBandit: [Damn... truly a Super Tycoon.]
TutorialBossVictim: [Spending a million on gifts directly, does he want us to live?]
Stan Harrison directly became the top contributor on Maya’s leaderboard.
It was simply inhumanly wealthy.
"Brother A Streak of Green on the Head, do you want to add my snapchat? I have already sent you a private message in the backend."
Maya Zimmerman said again.
NPCWithAnxiety: [Streamer, you need to stay steady, don’t be bought by the rich guy.]
NoisyAF: You’ve changed, actually taking the initiative to add a man’s snapchat.]
The PK between Xander and Maya Zimmerman ended quickly; because of Stan Harrison’s participation, Xander was defeated miserably.
But Stan Harrison’s gifting did not stop; he kept sending gifts.
Kept sending and sending.
Thirty minutes later.
SUPER ROCKET × 2300
Only after spending all the money did Stan Harrison stop.
[Ding. Construction Bank income 10,600,000 dollars.]
Maya Zimmerman: Favorability 34
Although Stan Harrison had sent many gifts, Maya Zimmerman’s favorability had not yet broken through fifty.
Stand himself found it unbelievable, but this was the best way he could think of, so he couldn’t stop. Otherwise with his reputation it’ll take forever to raise a random girls’ favorability to 50...
Maya was already numb, looking completely bewildered.
It was her first time encountering such a big scene.
"Min’er, hurry and pinch me; I suspect I’m dreaming."
"Maya, you’ve made a fortune! This rich guy just sent you nearly five million in gifts."
Maya Zimmerman’s live stream room reached an unprecedented 300,000 concurrent viewers.
"Thank you, Brother A Streak of Green on the Head, for the gifts, thank you, Brother."
"Brother A Streak of Green on the Head, can you send me your snapchat? I’ll add your snapchat after I finish the stream."
Maya made a heart gesture in front of the screen, her voice very sweet.
After Maya ended the stream, the first thing she did was add Stan Harrison’s snapchat.
"What? A Streak of Green on the Head is my friend? He is Stan Harrison?"
Maya Zimmerman looked at her friend list in disbelief.
She had met Stan Harrison a few times before, and although she had Stan Harrison’s snapchat, they hadn’t had any interaction.
’Does that mean the usually low-key Stan Harrison is a wealthy man with status?’
Stan Harrison opened Snapchat and received a message from Maya.
"Classmate Stan Harrison, thank you for the gifts you sent me. Tomorrow night at seven, let me treat you to dinner, just to thank you for your generous support."
"What? The campus belle is inviting me to dinner?"
Stan Harrison was a bit surprised; he hadn’t expected that one day Maya would take the initiative to invite him to dinner.
You have to know, Maya held the title of the cold goddess at Peak University.
The men pursuing her could line up around the sports field, but Maya had never spoken to any of them.
Those who took the initiative to chat her up could only exchange a few words with her at most.
Now, the other party was actually taking the initiative to invite him to dinner?
"Sure, it’s my honor to be able to eat with the campus belle."
Stan Harrison typed back.
"It’s a deal then. Seven-thirty, at the school gate, be there or be square."
"Don’t be late."
Stan Harrison and Maya Zimmerman were chatting heatedly.
"Stan Harrison, come play ranked, I’ll rank you up to Legendary in call of duty," Zack Howard a friend shouted from beside Stan...
"Hurry up, I need one more guy to complete the squad, getting ranked up by an op player like me should be a dream of yours right?."
"Not playing... I’m chatting with the campus belle."
"What? Chatting with the campus belle? Stop bragging!" Zack scoffed before proceeding to invite randoms from the game’s world chat since Stan refused his invitation...
The next afternoon, at the gate of Peak University.
A young woman wearing a black jacket, white sneakers, and her golden hair tied up high had been waiting there for over ten minutes.
There were many people coming and going, but this woman’s head-turning rate was nearly ninety percent; even women couldn’t help but look back a few more times.
A pair of slender legs, paired with black cropped trousers, was truly eye-catching.
When the boys’ eyes saw this woman, they couldn’t look away, staring straight at her.
"Isn’t that the campus belle, Maya Zimmerman?"
"Looks like she’s waiting for someone."
Just at this moment.
An audi a8 drove towards Maya Zimmerman and stopped at the school gate.
A young man, one meter eighty centimetres tall, walked straight up to Maya Zimmerman.
"Maya, where are you going? Let’s go together."
"No, I’ve already made plans with someone," Maya Zimmerman shook her head and refused.
"Who did you make plans with? Call them along, let’s go eat at the Warm Springs Restaurant, my treat."
"No."
Maya Zimmerman was not swayed by the luxury car he was driving.
It was just an audi a8, worth only a little over a million; one had to know that the gifts Stan Harrison sent yesterday were worth nearly five million.
Zane’s expression was a bit ugly.
He hadn’t expected Maya Zimmerman to be so hard to pursue.
Ever since he met Maya Zimmerman at a party last time, he had sworn to win her over within half a month.
But now, almost a month had passed, and there was no progress at all.
This time, driving a million-plus audi a8, he hadn’t expected to be rejected again; he had never encountered such a thing.
Just then...
A young man dressed simply, riding a bicycle, arrived in front of the two.
"Heh, riding a bicycle and wanting to hit on the campus belle? Maya doesn’t even bother with me when I drive an audi a8, so what right do you, a cyclist, have to hit on Maya?"
Zane snorted coldly in his heart.
"Oh Maya, you came earlier than I expected you would..." Stan Harrison said casually completely ignoring Zane.
He wasn’t late; it was exactly seven-thirty.
Thinking that Maya Zimmerman might need to put on makeup or something and might arrive later, Stan Harrison had timed his arrival perfectly.
He hadn’t expected the dignified campus belle Maya Zimmerman to arrive at the meeting spot ten minutes early.
"It’s okay, let’s go!"
Saying this, Maya Zimmerman sat on the back seat of Stan Harrison’s bicycle.
As she left, she didn’t forget to greet Zane: "Senior Zane, we’re leaving."
Watching Stan Harrison’s back, Zane felt a bit chaotic.
’What was going on?’
A person riding a bicycle had taken away the girl he had his eye on right in front of him.
This was simply not taking him seriously at all.
"A loser, actually daring to compete with me for a girl? Tired of living."
Zane snorted coldly and drove away.
Zane wouldn’t give up on Maya Zimmerman; he would let Stan Harrison know what reality was.
"Is this the legendary true love?"
"Who is that man? How could he hook up with the campus belle?"
"What’s going on?"
The people around were feeling very complex emotions.
To be able to hit on the campus belle with just a bicycle, he really had some skills.
"Me and that guy needs to be merged for real. Don’t envy me and brother, brother is just a legend like me fr."

’Does that mean the usually low-key Stan Harrison is a wealthy man with status?’
Stan Harrison opened Snapchat and received a message from Maya.
"Classmate Stan Harrison, thank you for the gifts you sent me.
Tomorrow night at seven, let me treat you to dinner, just to thank you for your generous support."
"What?
The campus belle is inviting me to dinner?"
Stan Harrison was a bit surprised; he hadn’t expected that one day Maya would take the initiative to invite him to dinner.
You have to know, Maya held the title of the cold goddess at Peak University.
The men pursuing her could line up around the sports field, but Maya had never spoken to any of them.
Those who took the initiative to chat her up could only exchange a few words with her at most.
Now, the other party was actually taking the initiative to invite him to dinner?
"Sure, it’s my honor to be able to eat with the campus belle."
Stan Harrison typed back.
"It’s a deal then.
Seven-thirty, at the school gate, be there or be square."
"Don’t be late."
Stan Harrison and Maya Zimmerman were chatting heatedly.
"Stan Harrison, come play ranked, I’ll rank you up to Legendary in call of duty," Zack Howard a friend shouted from beside Stan...
"Hurry up, I need one more guy to complete the squad, getting ranked up by an op player like me should be a dream of yours right?."
"Not playing...
I’m chatting with the campus belle."
"What?
Chatting with the campus belle?
Stop bragging!" Zack scoffed before proceeding to invite randoms from the game’s world chat since Stan refused his invitation...
The next afternoon, at the gate of Peak University.
A young woman wearing a black jacket, white sneakers, and her golden hair tied up high had been waiting there for over ten minutes.
There were many people coming and going, but this woman’s head-turning rate was nearly ninety percent; even women couldn’t help but look back a few more times.
A pair of slender legs, paired with black cropped trousers, was truly eye-catching.
When the boys’ eyes saw this woman, they couldn’t look away, staring straight at her.
"Isn’t that the campus belle, Maya Zimmerman?"
"Looks like she’s waiting for someone."
Just at this moment.
An audi a8 drove towards Maya Zimmerman and stopped at the school gate.
A young man, one meter eighty centimetres tall, walked straight up to Maya Zimmerman.
"Maya, where are you going?
Let’s go together."
"No, I’ve already made plans with someone," Maya Zimmerman shook her head and refused.
"Who did you make plans with?
Call them along, let’s go eat at the Warm Springs Restaurant, my treat."
"No."
Maya Zimmerman was not swayed by the luxury car he was driving.
It was just an audi a8, worth only a little over a million; one had to know that the gifts Stan Harrison sent yesterday were worth nearly five million.
Zane’s expression was a bit ugly.
He hadn’t expected Maya Zimmerman to be so hard to pursue.
Ever since he met Maya Zimmerman at a party last time, he had sworn to win her over within half a month.
But now, almost a month had passed, and there was no progress at all.
This time, driving a million-plus audi a8, he hadn’t expected to be rejected again; he had never encountered such a thing.
Just then...
A young man dressed simply, riding a bicycle, arrived in front of the two.
"Heh, riding a bicycle and wanting to hit on the campus belle?
Maya doesn’t even bother with me when I drive an audi a8, so what right do you, a cyclist, have to hit on Maya?"
Zane snorted coldly in his heart.
"Oh Maya, you came earlier than I expected you would..." Stan Harrison said casually completely ignoring Zane.
He wasn’t late; it was exactly seven-thirty.
Thinking that Maya Zimmerman might need to put on makeup or something and might arrive later, Stan Harrison had timed his arrival perfectly.
He hadn’t expected the dignified campus belle Maya Zimmerman to arrive at the meeting spot ten minutes early.
"It’s okay, let’s go!"
Saying this, Maya Zimmerman sat on the back seat of Stan Harrison’s bicycle.
As she left, she didn’t forget to greet Zane: "Senior Zane, we’re leaving."
Watching Stan Harrison’s back, Zane felt a bit chaotic.
’What was going on?’
A person riding a bicycle had taken away the girl he had his eye on right in front of him.
This was simply not taking him seriously at all.
"A loser, actually daring to compete with me for a girl?
Tired of living."
Zane snorted coldly and drove away.
Zane wouldn’t give up on Maya Zimmerman; he would let Stan Harrison know what reality was.
"Is this the legendary true love?"
"Who is that man?
How could he hook up with the campus belle?"
"What’s going on?"
The people around were feeling very complex emotions.
To be able to hit on the campus belle with just a bicycle, he really had some skills.
"Me and that guy needs to be merged for real.
Don’t envy me and brother, brother is just a legend like me fr."

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Regret Begins!
paragraphs: Inside the bubble tea shop.
Stan and Maya sat across from each other.
In front of them, there was a cup of overpriced viral bubble tea.
And Maya was the one who paid for it!
At this moment, Maya rested her hands on the table, her fair, jade-like palms cupping her delicate chin like a lotus flower.
"Stan, thank you for the tip yesterday."
Maya thanked him in a soft, gentle voice.
For a moment, Stan was captivated. The reputation of Maya being the campus belle was certainly no exaggeration; both her voice and her face were incredibly alluring.
This beauty completely outclassed Lily by more than a few blocks.
Fortunately, Stan had willpower; anyone else would have already been soul-snatched by Maya.
"How about this, let me buy you an outfit as a token of my thanks."
Maya brought Stan to a CUCCi men’s clothing store.
Just as they walked into the clothing store.
They ran into acquaintances.
Leo had his arm around Lily’s shoulders, and the two were picking out clothes.
Suddenly, Lily’s gaze turned icy; seeing Stan was like seeing a mortal enemy.
"Stan, are you still pestering me? We’ve already broken up, please have some self-respect."
Stan frowned slightly. It was truly unlucky; he was out shopping with the campus belle, and he had to run into his ex-girlfriend.
"You’ve misunderstood, I’m just here to buy clothes," Stan explained.
Hearing that Stan was there to buy clothes, Lily scoffed disdainfully: "Buy clothes? Can you even afford the clothes here?"
She knew exactly what Stan was worth. A man who only ate at street stalls, would he come to buy clothes worth over ten thousand dollars? Impossible.
Stan shook his head, not bothering to explain.
Leo, with his arm around Lily’s waist, held up a suit jacket and asked the Waiter: "How much is this?"
"Thirty-two thousand dollars."
"Only thirty thousand? That’s so cheap, I’ll take it..."

Leo had deliberately chosen a relatively expensive piece of clothing to show off his wealth in front of Stan. He held Lily’s waist and stood in front of Stan, flaunting his status with a provocative air.
"Some people won’t be able to afford clothes this expensive in their entire lifetime." Leo deliberately drew out his voice, implying something.
Maya walked up to Stan holding a black jacket, "I picked out a piece of clothing for you. Do you like it?"
"I like it."
"Please wrap this up." Maya handed the clothes to the Waiter and said slowly.
Leo looked astonished.
The garment in Maya’s hand was no ordinary item; it was a limited-edition luxury piece, the most expensive item in the shop, costing over a hundred thousand dollars.
Although Leo had money, he couldn’t bear to buy something so expensive.
’What was going on? Wasn’t this person the campus belle? How did she get so close to Stan?’
After seeing Maya, Leo suddenly felt that Lily by his side wasn’t quite as appealing.
Whether it was her looks or her figure, Maya outclassed Lily by more than a few blocks.
"Maya, what a coincidence?" Leo took the initiative to greet Maya.
Maya just gave Leo a cold glance and ignored him.
Leo gritted his teeth in embarrassment and glared fiercely at Stan.
A loser like Stan had actually hooked up with the Peak University campus belle, which made Leo extremely unhappy.
"Maya, where are you going? My Audi is parked outside, do you want a ride?"
Leo tried to hit on her again.
"No need."
Maya coldly refused.
She had seen the conflict between Leo and Stan just now, and Stan was the man who had tipped her nearly five million.
Maya wouldn’t offend Stan just because of Leo.
Maya linked her arm with Stan’s and said in an intimate tone: "Having Stan accompany me is enough."
The corners of Stan’s mouth curled up; he felt a bit smug inside. Maya was so good at handling things; this one sentence gave him a huge boost of face.
While obviously she’s like this because of his money, it was still a good thing that Stan can take advantage of...
Leo clenched his fists tightly, his eyes turning red with frustration. He was unwilling to accept it; a stinking loser like Stan had actually hooked up with the campus belle.
Maya brought Stan to the CUCCi women’s clothing store next door and bought a few pieces of clothing for herself.
Leo, meanwhile, brought Lily along to the women’s clothing store as well.
"Lily, whatever clothes you like, just buy them. Don’t worry about them being too expensive, I have money."
As he spoke, Leo deliberately glanced at Stan, implying something.
Stan shook his head silently with a smile, ’Leo is just too childish, is this what Lily left me for... So funny seeing him childishly trying so hard to irk me...’
Meanwhile, Maya took her bank card and went to the counter to pay.
Seeing Maya checking out, a cold sneer appeared on Leo’s face. He walked up to Stan and mocked him: "Stan, why are you letting a woman pay the bill?"
"What? Are you too poor to have any money?"
"Leo my love, the clothes here start at ten thousand. A loser like Stan simply can’t afford them." Lily chimed in mockingly.
"Oh, if you hadn’t mentioned it, I would have almost forgotten; Stan is just a penniless, stinking loser." Leo and Lily sang in unison to humiliate Stan.
’Could he endure this?’ they thought, not knowing how bad they were embarrassing themselves.
Originally, Stan didn’t want to show off, but this Leo had gone too far.
It seemed he had no choice but to show off today.
Stan moved casually toward Maya.
Leo, standing to the side, was stunned: "What’s going on? Is this guy going to pay the bill?"
Seeing Stan walking toward her, Maya teased: "What’s wrong? Are you going to pay for me?"
Stan shook his head, "No."

A look of disappointment flashed in Maya’s eyes. Thinking about it, that made sense; she and Stan only had an ordinary relationship. Although Stan had tipped her nearly five million in her livestream, they were still just acquaintances. It was their first time out eating together, and Stan had no obligation to buy her clothes.
"Putting on an act, you broke loser, still can’t afford the clothes, can you?" Leo mocked.
"You scared me, I actually thought this guy was going to pay!" Lily also breathed a sigh of relief.
How could Stan possibly pay?
You see, a piece of clothing Lily bought was only twenty thousand dollars. Even with a double rebate, it would only return forty thousand dollars. No matter how you calculated it, it was a loss.
Since he was going to show off, he might as well do it big.
"I’ll buy every piece of clothing in this store." Stan waved his arm, pointing at the clothes in the room.
The atmosphere instantly went quiet.
"All the clothes?"
The Waiter suspected they had misheard and asked again.
"That’s right, all of them."
Since he was going to pay, he definitely had to spend as much as possible.
You have to understand, he only had two opportunities for consumption rebates per week; if he spent too little, it would be a huge loss.
Maya grabbed Stan’s arm and said in a gentle tone: "You don’t need to buy so many clothes, it’s too wasteful. Just buying one piece is enough."
[Maya: Favorability 34]
[Maya: Favorability 37]
[Maya: Favorability 40]
[Maya: Favorability 49]
[Maya: Favorability 53]
[Favorability surpassed 50; next consumption will receive a five-fold rebate.]
She said she didn’t need him to buy them, but Maya’s favorability was skyrocketing.
Stan was somewhat excited; it had only been two days, and her favorability had already surpassed 50. If things continued to develop like this, reaching 100 favorability wasn’t just a dream.
He was one step closer to becoming a billionaire tycoon.
"No need to be polite with me, it’s just a little pocket change, not wasteful at all."
"Forget it, just buying one piece is fine," Maya said again.
Stan sighed inwardly. ’One piece of clothing? How could that work? Wouldn’t that stop me from making more money?’

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Swipe It All!
paragraphs: "No, we must buy all of them." Stan Harrison was very firm.
’Was Stan Harrison giving her such a huge gift because he liked her?’
Maya’s cheeks flushed slightly, and she felt a bit embarrassed, her face showing shyness.
"Buy them all? All the clothes in this shop added together cost over one million dollars. Can you afford that?" Leo mocked Stan disdainfully.
Stan didn’t say a word, but handed his bank card to the waiter and said, "Swipe the card."
[This transaction is 1,260,000 dollars. You have received a double rebate of 2,520,000 dollars.]

"He really swiped the card?" Leo couldn’t believe what he was seeing. Even he couldn’t come up with over one million dollars, yet Stan Harrison had spent over one million dollars without even blinking. This was very shocking.
Leo felt a bit flustered at this moment. Wasn’t Stan Harrison just a penniless loser? How did he suddenly transform into a rich tycoon?
Lily found it hard to accept this reality. Looking at Stan Harrison’s departing back, she actually felt some regret over breaking up with him.
Meanwhile, back at the Zimmerman Family.
Maya was a treasured daughter of the Zimmerman family, so they kept tabs on her.
So when she went out with Stan, the Zimmermans had definitely noticed and were trying to investigate his background. After all, it was unlike their daughter to go out with anyone.
"Have you found out clearly? Who was eating with my daughter?" the head of the Zimmerman family asked in a cold voice.
"It is a college student named Stan Harrison."
"A college student with no background dares to hit on my daughter? Go send him my prized vintage wine and give him a hint."
"Understood," the man in black replied respectfully before quietly leaving.
Back at the dormitory, Stan Harrison received a message from Lily admitting her mistake.
"Stan Harrison, I was wrong before. I shouldn’t have broken up with you. I was just momentarily possessed. Can you forgive me?"
A cold sneer appeared on the corner of Stan Harrison’s mouth. Lily was truly shameless; upon discovering he had money, she actually came crawling back to him.
If it were before, perhaps Stan Harrison would have forgiven Lily.

But now, it was impossible to forgive her. He was no longer the simp he was before. This time, he’ll make sure that his relationship with girls is the other way around, with girls simping over him, not him simping over girls...
"Get lost," he replied coldly, not even batting an eye.

Lily was completely shaken by how blatantly Stan had rejected her... Considering how he had treated her before she broke up with him, she knew he genuinely loved her, and he was quite handsome himself, but she just couldn’t be with someone without money, so she had to leave...

But knowing his feelings for her previously, when she came back, even though she was pleading so earnestly, she had some confidence that he would accept her back, but now everything had been completely shattered...
Meanwhile, after sending that one word, Stan Harrison blocked Lily on Snapchat.
Stan Harrison’s mind was now completely occupied by the system. He had already spent money on Maya Zimmerman twice; the next time he could spend money would be in seven days.
He had to bind another heroine; only then could he earn more consumption rebates. He couldn’t just hang himself on one tree.
Bored, Stan Harrison began scrolling through TikTuk to find a woman with a beauty rating of 8 points or higher.
Soon, Stan Harrison locked onto a woman, Sarah, the third-ranked campus belle of Peak University, whose beauty was on par with Maya Zimmerman.
He just happened to swipe onto Sarah’s video.
Sarah had posted a video: "My family is in crisis, I need to borrow one million dollars. Is anyone willing to lend it to me? I guarantee I will pay it back, and I can write an IOU."
In the comment section, there was also Sarah’s Snapchat.
Seeing this video, Stan Harrison was overjoyed. He had been worrying about how to establish a connection with Sarah, and he hadn’t expected to stumble upon her video asking for money.
As expected, anything that can be solved with money is not a problem.
Stan Harrison added Sarah on SnapChat.
"Hello, may I borrow one million dollars?"
"Yes, but I need to have a video call with you."
Only through a video call could he bind the relationship with Sarah as a consumption rebate target. As for borrowing money?
Never mind one million dollars, even if it were two million dollars, Stan Harrison would lend it all the same.
In less than a minute, Sarah’s video call came through.
In the video, Sarah was wearing a pink pajama set. Although it was just pajamas, it still couldn’t hide her beautiful face. Her eyes were slightly damp, as if she had been crying.
She didn’t know how many video calls this had been, but everyone just wanted to see her in person, and no one actually intended to lend her money.

Some even thought she was joking, that all this was just content to go viral, not knowing how serious she was. She was very serious about this, considering that she would write and sign an IOU document to acknowledge the debt...
At this point, after trying for so long, Sarah’s mood was at an all-time low. She was only trying her luck when she made the video call to Stan.

She was only trying her luck when she made the video call to Stan.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: A Billion-dollar Risk!
paragraphs: [Sarah: Beauty 8.7 points, can bind as a consumption rebate target. Do you want to bind?]
"Bind."
[Binding successful, received reward: a box of tea]

Bruce was surprised by the meager thing he received as a reward. Every time he bound a woman, he would receive a reward. Last time the reward was one million dollars, so he had his hopes high, but this time it was just a box of tea. His hopes of getting something of good value were completely shattered...
’So the system gives useless things too...’ Stan sighed inwardly.
Meanwhile, after binding, a notification appeared...
[Sarah: Favorability −10]
’Negative? That’s a first. I’ve not even spoken to her yet.’ Stan frowned upon seeing it. He was a bit confused; this was his first time encountering negative favorability.
’Is my infamous reputation that bad that a girl will have negative favorability towards me when I’ve done nothing wrong to her...’

The video call hung in silence for a beat too long. Stan was still processing the negative notification, and the pause stretched into something awkward. Sarah, apparently tired of waiting, spoke first.
"Can you lend me the money or not? If you can’t, I’m deleting your number." Her voice carried a dull edge of disappointment, not quite hostile, but close.
Stan’s expression cooled. "Is that how you talk to someone who’s offering to help? Keep that up and I might just change my mind."
Sarah froze. The words hit her like cold water.

She thought of how many times she’d reached out to people recently, how many of them had turned her down, strung her along, or flat-out ignored her. Somewhere along the way, she’d stopped expecting anything good. And now she’d nearly pushed away the one person who might actually come through.
She bowed her head. "I’m sorry. I’ve been let down too many times, and I took it out on you."
Stan waved it off. "It’s fine. Just send me your card number. Let’s get this done."
The heaviness in Sarah’s face vanished instantly. She sent her details without a second thought.
"Sent."
"Got it. Transferring now."
[Sarah: Favorability +10]
[Sarah: Favorability +20]
Stan completed the transfer.
A few seconds later, Sarah let out a sharp breath.
"Ten million dollars?! Did you, did you type the wrong amount?"
She stared at the balance on her screen like it might glitch and correct itself. Ten million?! She had never seen that many digits attached to her name!
"I accidentally added an extra zero," Stan said casually.
That was a lie. The extra zero was very much intentional.
[Double rebate received: $20,000,000.]
A faint smile tugged at the corner of his mouth.
Sarah, meanwhile, was reeling. ’He haven’t asked for an IOU. Haven’t set conditions. Just sent the money. Like it was nothing. Does he... have feelings for me?’
It was only natural she thought like this, after all It’s the only explanation that made sense. If not, why else would anyone be this generous?
"I can’t accept this much. Let me transfer the extra back..."
[Warning: Funds spent on a consumption rebate target are non-recoverable. Attempted recovery will incur a penalty of 100× the consumed amount.]
Stan’s stomach dropped. ’A billion-dollar penalty. Wonderful.’
"Don’t," he said, sharper than he intended.
Sarah flinched. "What’s wrong?"
"Just because I typed an extra zero, you want to throw it back in my face? Are you looking down on me?"
"No need to pay it back."

Sarah was stunned for a moment. ’Ten million dollars is not a small amount, yet he’s actually telling me not to pay it back. Could there be some kind of trap? Could he be trying to use ten million dollars to coerce me into doing something lewd?’
[Sarah: Favorability 18]
[Sarah: Favorability 15]
Seeing Sarah’s favorability dropping, Stan knew he must have said the wrong thing and quickly corrected himself.
"You don’t need to pay it back for now. When I ask you for the money, then you can give it to me."
Sarah hesitated for a moment and replied, "Alright!"
"Thank you. How about I treat you to a meal tomorrow?"
"Sure," Stan readily agreed.
"Stan! Someone is here for you!" His roommate Zack’s voice rang from the hallway.

’Why are women’s minds so complicated? Despite having sent her that huge amount, her favorability still dropped. Whatever, It’s a good thing it didn’t drop by much.’ Stan sighed as he set his phone down, stood up from his bed, and headed for the door. Upon coming out he looked at the figure waiting for him with furrowed brows.
A man in a tailored black suit stood waiting outside the dormitory, sunglasses on despite the overcast sky. He carried a bottle of red wine like it was a scepter.
"Mr. Harrison." The man smiled. "I’m here on behalf of the Chairman. He asked me to deliver this as a welcoming gift."
Stan stared at the bottle, then at the man. "Chairman? I think you’ve got the wrong person."
"You are Stan Harrison, correct?"
"...Yeah."
"Then there’s no mistake. Our Chairman is Maya’s father."
Stan went quiet. ’Maya’s father sent someone to find me?’
"The Chairman hopes you’ll accept this small token of goodwill." The man extended the bottle again.
"I don’t drink. But thank you."
As the saying goes, taking gifts from others makes one feel indebted. Receiving a gift for no reason just felt wrong.
There was no reason to accept gifts from strangers, especially strangers with money and motives he didn’t understand.
At the same time, the suit-clad man’s eyes flashed, and he revealed a meaningful smile. "You don’t have to drink it. A 1997 Romanée-Conti goes for over two hundred thousand on the open market."

chapters.title: Chapter 6: The Price of Misjudgment!
paragraphs: "You don’t have to drink it. A 1997 Romanée-Conti goes for over two hundred thousand on the open market."
Stan studied the bottle for a moment, then looked back at the man. A gift worth two hundred thousand dollars, delivered out of nowhere, there had to be something behind it.
"Two hundred thousand is a lot of money to spend on someone you’ve never met."
The suit-clad man held Stan’s gaze, his smile thinning into something more deliberate.
"For most people, yes. It would be."

The implication was barely hidden. It was as if he was saying, you’re no one. You have nothing. And you’re not worthy of Maya. It was an open but subtle way of declaring the Zimmerman family stance on Stan’s friendship with Maya.
Stan noticed it, smiled, and shook his head. He couldn’t be bothered with matters like this. He ignored the meaning behind the suit-clad man’s words entirely...
He let out a low sigh...
"Hold on a second." Saying this, he walked back into the dormitory, rummaged through his things, and returned carrying a plain wooden box.
Inside were the tea leaves, the system’s reward from earlier. Stan didn’t drink tea, and despite their intent, he wasn’t about to let someone give him a gift without offering something in return.
The suit-clad man blinked, clearly not expecting a reciprocal gesture from a broke college student. But he accepted the box with a polite nod and left without another word.
Twenty minutes later, the man stood before a broad mahogany desk in a private study. The surroundings were dark, so one couldn’t see much...
But one could see the dark silhouette of an elderly man tracing something on a board. It was unknown what he was doing...
"Sir, the young man, Stan Harrison, sent you a box of tea in return."
Mr. Zimmerman didn’t look up from his papers. A box of tea from a college kid was hardly worth acknowledging.
"Keep it. It’s yours."
The suit-clad man gave a small bow and lifted the lid.
The fragrance hit the room like a wave.
It was layered, ancient, and impossibly refined. The scent was so good and rich that the suit-clad man’s hands went still the next second...
Mr. Zimmerman’s pen stopped mid-stroke.
He knew that fragrance. He’d encountered it exactly once in his life, decades ago, inside the private reception hall of the Valemont estate in Aurum City.
Celestine Leaf.

The Valemont family was one of the Nine Sovereign Houses, with bloodlines stretching back over eight hundred years to the Age of Crowns. Families whose influence didn’t merely shape nations but predated them.
And Celestine Leaf was the tea the Valemonts reserved for a single purpose: receiving guests of equal standing. Other Sovereign patriarchs. Figures whose names moved markets and toppled governments.
It was never served casually. Never gifted. Never seen outside those walls.

Mr. Zimmerman had only tasted it once, and even then, only because his father-in-law, an elder-level figure within one of the Nine Houses, had brought him along as a companion to the family patriarch. He’d been permitted a single cup. One sip, seated at the far end of the table, barely acknowledged by the hosts.
That memory was thirty years old, and he could still taste it. From this alone, one could tell how rich those tea leaves were...
Now that same tea was sitting in a plain wooden box, handed over by a twenty-year-old college student like it was a courtesy gift from a convenience store.
’How could he possibly have this?’
Mr. Zimmerman rose slowly from his chair.
’And he just gave it away? Without a second thought?’
The realization crept in like ice water through his veins.
It’s impossible to buy the Celestine Leaf. It wasn’t sold. It wasn’t traded. It existed within the Sovereign Houses and nowhere else, passed between bloodlines as a matter of protocol, not commerce.
Which meant the boy hadn’t purchased it.
He had it.
And for someone to have it so naturally, so unremarkably, that parting with it meant nothing to him meant only one thing...
Mr. Zimmerman’s hands trembled against the edge of his desk.
’A direct descendant. Sent out for tempering.’

It was the only explanation that fit. The Sovereign Houses had done it before, placing their heirs in ordinary lives, stripped of status and privilege, to test their character before granting them true authority.
And he had just sent a man to that boy’s doorstep to imply he wasn’t good enough for his daughter.
A thin bead of sweat rolled down Mr. Zimmerman’s temple.
’What have I done?’
Back in the dormitory, Stan lay on his bed staring at the ceiling. Sleep wasn’t coming. His mind kept circling back to the same thought, the double rebate.
Ten million in, twenty million back. The math was almost too clean.
Sighing, he pulled out his phone and opened TikTuk Live.
’If spending money on bound targets triggered the rebate, then the fastest way to scale was volume, and livestream gifting was the most frictionless way to burn through cash.’
He scrolled through the top channels until one name caught his eye.
Xenia.
She was one of TikTuk’s most popular female streamers, with nearly two million followers, a regular fixture on the platform’s trending charts. Word was she lived somewhere on Inksea Island too.
[Xenia: Beauty Rating 8.9. Can bind as a consumption rebate target. Bind?]
"Bind."
[Binding successful. Reward: 30% of Wanhai Group shares.]
Stan’s eyes widened slightly, but he filed it away. He could look into that later. Right now, he had work to do.
He tapped into Xenia’s room.
Entering the stream, he found her singing, her soft and soothing voice instantly drawing people in.
Under the warm lighting, she looked stunning, her flawless, delicate skin glowing gently, her presence both elegant and captivating.
Every small movement carried a natural grace, making it hard to look away.
More than just her beauty, it was the atmosphere she created, calm, mesmerizing, and almost spellbinding, that made the entire stream feel silent, as if no one dared to interrupt her moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Master Streak!
paragraphs: The chat was lively but not explosive. Her room had a comfortable base of twenty-odd Kings and a dozen Emperors, all regulars who kept the gift economy ticking.
Kings and Emperor’s are ranks specifically for people who had spent a certain amount of money on streams. They all have their own benefits and features..
At that the notification dropped.
[A Streak of Green on the Head has activated Emperor status in Xenia’s room.]
The red Emperor banner blazed across every active stream on the platform...
The chat detonated.
ToeSnifferSupreme: [The super tycoon is HERE!!!]
SirYeetsALot: [Wait. Is this the guy who dropped five million the other night?]
PancakeBandit: [Has to be. Who else activates Emperor on entry like that?]
MainCharacterDelusion: [Bro walked in like he owns the building.]

Xenia’s eyes lit up. She’d heard the rumors. Some anonymous whale had been burning through millions in gifts across the platform, appearing and disappearing without warning. And now he was in her room.
She wasn’t about to let him leave.
"Thank you so much for joining, Master Streak!" She clasped her hands together, beaming. "Let me dance for you. Consider it a welcome gift from me to you."

She launched into a choreographed routine, all smiles and energy. She danced to a cute song, her boobs and curves swinging, gracing all the viewers with such a great sight. It was clear she was putting great effort to hook Stan to her stream...
GrandmaWithAShotgun: [Is this the power of money? 😭]
EmotionalDamageDealer: [Streamer, you’ve changed. You used to have principles.]
Then the rockets started.
Super Rocket × 10
Super Rocket × 50
Super Rocket × 100
Super Rocket × 200
SirYeetsALot: [HE’S GOING!!!]
PancakeBandit: [WHY IS HE STILL GOING???!!!]
PlotArmorExpired: [Here we go again... hide your wallets!]
ToeSnifferSupreme: [All hail the big boss 🙇♂️]

Stan wasn’t watching the chat. He wasn’t watching Xenia dance. His thumb moved with mechanical precision, tap, confirm, tap, confirm, feeding rockets into the room like coins into a slot machine that only paid out in doubles.
Xenia’s viewer count had been hovering around three million. Within minutes, it blew past five. Then eight. Then ten million, rocketing her straight to the top of TikTuk’s live rankings.

"Thank you. Master Streak. Thank you so much." Xenia’s composure was cracking. She was bowing between words, hands clasped, voice trembling. "What song would you like? Anything. Name it. I’ll sing whatever you want."
No response. Stan was still gifting.
Super Rocket × 300
Super Rocket × 400
Super Rocket × 500
Super Rocket × 600
1HPAndCrying: [Bro just pressed "skip poverty arc" 💀]
LagIsMySuperpower: [It’s been thirty minutes and he hasn’t stopped.]
UnpaidInternOfChaos: [This man is not human.]
ReportMeForExisting: [BRO IS HE OKAY???]
CarriedByLuck: [At this point he owns the platform]
CtrlAltDefeat: [Someone unplug him PLEASE]
IQOnAirplaneMode: [I blinked and he dropped my rent for 2 years]
ChickenNuggetOverlord: [This isn’t gifting... this is terrorism 😭]
NoThoughtsJustVibes: [He’s not a viewer, he’s the FINAL BOSS]
RespawnAndRegret: [Streamer just unlocked sugar daddy DLC]
Time passed quickly. Thirty minutes became forty. Forty became fifty.
Super Rocket × 999
Super Rocket × 1,000
Super Rocket × 3,000
Super Rocket × 5,000
FuelPriceBossFight: [He just swept the top of the global rankings in under an hour.]
LostToAFish: [I’m watching history.]
YourDadOnWiFi: [Son... come home... we need this money 😭]
MoistBreadEnjoyer: [I feel poor just watching this]
P_Diddy: [He just bought my entire bloodline]

The numbers were staggering. Over five thousand Super Rockets, ten million dollars in raw gifting value. After the platform’s fifty-percent cut, Xenia stood to pocket over five million in personal income from a single session.

To put that in perspective, her previous top donor had dropped eight million over the course of months, and that money had been funneled through her management guild. Every dollar had to be returned. It was house money, not hers.
This was different. This was real.
Xenia was losing her mind on camera.
"Master Streak, I’ve already sent you a Snapchat request. Please accept it!
There was no response, just a heavy silence...
"Master Streak, why are you ignoring me?"
Nothing.
"Am I not cute enough?"
Still nothing.
"Master Streak...?"
SirYeetsALot: [Streamer, you’ve changed. You are actually simping.]
SkrrtOnCooldown: [Is this the same ice queen who told her last Emperor to ’calm down’?]
CarriedByLuck: [At this point he owns the platform]
[Xenia: Favorability +20]
Stan finally stopped.
<Ding!>
[US Construction Bank. Incoming: $21,012,000.]
Over twenty million in returns. The rebate system was holding. At this rate, a billion wasn’t a fantasy.
But when he glanced at Xenia’s stats, his enthusiasm dimmed.
[Xenia: Favorability 20]
’Still twenty. The same number it had been after the first few rockets. Ten million dollars later and the needle hadn’t moved a single point.’

’interesting,’ Stan thought flatly. ’so money alone doesn’t move everyone equally, women mindset are so complex, they love money so much but it’s still hard to raise their favourability by gifting them.’
Sighing, he accepted her Snapchat request. A message came almost instantly.
"Master Streak! Are you on Inksea Island too? Are you free tomorrow? Let’s grab a meal. My treat!"
Her eagerness practically vibrated through the screen. Stan Harrison was a whale of legendary proportions; getting close to him could only mean good things.
"No. I have plans tomorrow."
He had dinner with Sarah. That came first. With tomorrow plans, it was simply impossible to meet up with Xenia.
He set the phone down and closed his eyes.

Within the hour, the story had already spread beyond Xenia’s room. The name A Streak of Green on the Head was on every streamer’s radar, whispered about in group chats, screenshotted in fan forums, dissected in reaction threads.

Female streamers across the platform bookmarked his profile. Some sent private messages, subtle invitations, not-so-subtle hints, everything from "I’d love to sing for you sometime" to photos that left very little to the imagination.
By morning, "Mysterious Tycoon Drops Millions on Female Streamer" had climbed onto Guugle’s trending search list.
Stan slept through all of it.

The chat detonated.

SirYeetsALot: [Wait.
Is this the guy who dropped five million the other night?]
PancakeBandit: [Has to be.
Who else activates Emperor on entry like that?]
MainCharacterDelusion: [Bro walked in like he owns the building.]
Xenia’s eyes lit up.
She’d heard the rumors.
Some anonymous whale had been burning through millions in gifts across the platform, appearing and disappearing without warning.
And now he was in her room.
She wasn’t about to let him leave.
"Thank you so much for joining, Master Streak!" She clasped her hands together, beaming.
"Let me dance for you.
Consider it a welcome gift from me to you."
She launched into a choreographed routine, all smiles and energy.
She danced to a cute song, her boobs and curves swinging, gracing all the viewers with such a great sight.
It was clear she was putting great effort to hook Stan to her stream...

EmotionalDamageDealer: [Streamer, you’ve changed.
You used to have principles.]
Then the rockets started.
Super Rocket × 10
Super Rocket × 50
Super Rocket × 100
Super Rocket × 200
SirYeetsALot: [HE’S GOING!!!]
PancakeBandit: [WHY IS HE STILL GOING???!!!]
PlotArmorExpired: [Here we go again... hide your wallets!]

He wasn’t watching Xenia dance.

Xenia’s viewer count had been hovering around three million.

Then ten million, rocketing her straight to the top of TikTuk’s live rankings.
"Thank you.
Master Streak.
Thank you so much." Xenia’s composure was cracking.

"What song would you like?
Anything.
Name it.
I’ll sing whatever you want."
No response.
Stan was still gifting.
Super Rocket × 300

ReportMeForExisting: [BRO IS HE OKAY???]
CarriedByLuck: [At this point he owns the platform]
CtrlAltDefeat: [Someone unplug him PLEASE]
IQOnAirplaneMode: [I blinked and he dropped my rent for 2 years]

Thirty minutes became forty.
Forty became fifty.
Super Rocket × 999
Super Rocket × 1,000
Super Rocket × 3,000
Super Rocket × 5,000

LostToAFish: [I’m watching history.]
YourDadOnWiFi: [Son... come home... we need this money 😭]
MoistBreadEnjoyer: [I feel poor just watching this]
P_Diddy: [He just bought my entire bloodline]

Over five thousand Super Rockets, ten million dollars in raw gifting value.
After the platform’s fifty-percent cut, Xenia stood to pocket over five million in personal income from a single session.
To put that in perspective, her previous top donor had dropped eight million over the course of months, and that money had been funneled through her management guild.
Every dollar had to be returned.
It was house money, not hers.
This was different.
This was real.
Xenia was losing her mind on camera.
"Master Streak, I’ve already sent you a Snapchat request.
Please accept it!
There was no response, just a heavy silence...
"Master Streak, why are you ignoring me?"
Nothing.
"Am I not cute enough?"
Still nothing.
"Master Streak...?"
SirYeetsALot: [Streamer, you’ve changed.
You are actually simping.]
SkrrtOnCooldown: [Is this the same ice queen who told her last Emperor to ’calm down’?]
CarriedByLuck: [At this point he owns the platform]
[Xenia: Favorability +20]
Stan finally stopped.
<Ding!>
[US Construction Bank.
Over twenty million in returns.
The rebate system was holding.
At this rate, a billion wasn’t a fantasy.
But when he glanced at Xenia’s stats, his enthusiasm dimmed.
[Xenia: Favorability 20]
’Still twenty.
The same number it had been after the first few rockets.
Ten million dollars later and the needle hadn’t moved a single point.’

’interesting,’ Stan thought flatly. ’so money alone doesn’t move everyone equally, women mindset are so complex, they love money so much but it’s still hard to raise their favourability by gifting them.’
Sighing, he accepted her Snapchat request.
A message came almost instantly.
"Master Streak!
Are you on Inksea Island too?
Are you free tomorrow?
Let’s grab a meal.
My treat!"
Her eagerness practically vibrated through the screen.
Stan Harrison was a whale of legendary proportions; getting close to him could only mean good things.
"No.
I have plans tomorrow."
He had dinner with Sarah.
That came first.
With tomorrow plans, it was simply impossible to meet up with Xenia.
He set the phone down and closed his eyes.

The name A Streak of Green on the Head was on every streamer’s radar, whispered about in group chats, screenshotted in fan forums, dissected in reaction threads.
Female streamers across the platform bookmarked his profile.
Some sent private messages, subtle invitations, not-so-subtle hints, everything from "I’d love to sing for you sometime" to photos that left very little to the imagination.
By morning, "Mysterious Tycoon Drops Millions on Female Streamer" had climbed onto Guugle’s trending search list.
Stan slept through all of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Twice Rejected, Once Broken!
paragraphs: At the entrance of Peak University, Sarah was wearing a grey jacket paired with white sneakers, her hair draped loosely over her shoulders. There was an effortless charm about her that made it impossible for the passing boys not to steal a second glance.
In terms of looks, she and Maya were equally matched.
An Audi A8 rolled to a stop not far away, and Zane stepped out, adjusting his collar before making his way toward her with the practiced ease of someone who had never once been told no.
"Sarah, what a coincidence. Want to grab a meal together?"
He had originally set his sights on Maya, but she had slipped right through his fingers and straight onto the back of some nobody’s bicycle.

The memory alone made his jaw tighten. Losing Maya to Stan had done a number on his pride, and the wound was still fresh. Sarah was his chance to cauterize it. In terms of beauty, she was every bit Maya’s equal, and that was more than enough.
But Sarah’s reply came without a moment’s hesitation.
"No, I already have plans with someone."

The words hit him like a blade. Zane blinked. He wasn’t lacking in looks. He wasn’t lacking in money. He had only just transferred to this university, and somehow he was already racking up rejections from its most beautiful women. Two in a row. The humiliation was staggering.
The calm, unremarkable face of a certain bicycle-riding nobody surfaced unbidden in his mind.
Zane gritted his teeth. ’No. I can’t accept this.’

He forced a smile and closed the distance between them, lowering his voice to something he imagined was charming. "Don’t be like that. I heard your family’s been having some trouble. Money’s tight, right? I have more than enough to spare."
As he said it, something possessed him to reach out and rest his arm around her waist, as though the gesture might tip the scales in his favor.
However, it did not.

Sarah’s expression cooled instantly. She shook his arm off with a sharp, unhurried motion and picked up her pace, putting distance between them without another word. The slight furrow of her brow said everything her silence didn’t.
"No need, the money issue has already been resolved," she said coldly after giving him some space...
Stan had already lent her ten million dollars. Whatever Zane was offering, she neither needed it nor wanted it, and his character alone was enough to turn her stomach.

Behind her, Zane stood frozen mid-step, watching her walk away. The last card he had planned to play had been dismissed before he even got to lay it on the table. He had nothing left to offer, no angle left to work, and he knew it.
Sarah wasn’t just out of reach. She was already gone.
As he stood there in silence, nursing the dull ache in his chest, the faint ring of a bicycle bell cut through the air behind him. Zane stepped aside on instinct and then went very still.
The rider was Stan.
He could do nothing but watch as Stan coasted to a smooth stop right beside Sarah, one foot dropping to the ground with casual ease.
"I’m late, sorry." Stan’s voice was unhurried, almost gentle.
Sarah shook her head, and something in her expression softened in a way it never had for Zane. "You’re not late. I just got here too early."
She had arrived a full hour ahead of time, though she would never admit that out loud.
Zane stared at the bicycle. Something about this felt deeply, horrifyingly familiar.
Then it clicked.

His hands curled slowly into fists at his sides, knuckles whitening as the pieces fell into place. Stan. A bicycle. A beautiful girl waiting for him with a softness in her eyes that money couldn’t buy. It was the same scene, beat for beat, only yesterday the girl had been Maya, and today it was Sarah.
’That’s impossible.’

The thought ricocheted around his skull, refusing to settle. Girls like Maya and Sarah were supposed to gravitate toward men like him, men with Audis, men with money, men with options. That was how the world worked. That was how it had always worked. So why were they both gravitating toward a guy whose greatest asset appeared to be a secondhand bicycle?
"How is it you again?" The words scraped out of him low and tight, not quite meant to be heard.
But Stan heard them.
He glanced over his shoulder, and his eyes were flat and cold and utterly unbothered.
"Yeah," he said simply. "Me again."

Stan’s voice was cold, flat, unfeeling, and it cut deeper than any insult ever could. Zane’s fingers curled into tight fists, his chest tightening as a familiar humiliation clawed its way up his throat. Never in his life had he been made to feel this small, this powerless.
Three words. That was all it took.
Meanwhile, Stan turned back to Sarah without another glance.
To Stan, Zane wasn’t special. It didn’t matter that he hadn’t done much personally, he carried the same arrogance, the same entitled air as Leo. That alone was enough.
And Stan hated that type.
Ironically, he could feel himself changing too. The system, with its cashback features, was slowly reshaping him, nudging him toward the very same excess and indulgence he despised.
But there was a difference. He was aware of it. And unlike them, he had no intention of being blind.
If anything, that awareness only sharpened his resolve.
People like Leo... people like Zane...
Stan wouldn’t hesitate to crush their pride completely.
They strutted through life thinking everything belonged to them, wealth, status... even women.

Maybe it was time they learned otherwise. Maybe it was time they experienced what it felt like to have something they believed was theirs taken away right in front of them, and be utterly powerless to stop it.

Meanwhile, Sarah settled onto the back of the bicycle, her arms looping around Stan’s waist with a natural ease, as though she had done it a hundred times before. As they pulled away, she glanced back over her shoulder.
"We’re heading off, Senior."
Then they were gone, rolling down the path together, unhurried and unbothered, growing smaller in the distance.
Zane stood rooted to the spot.
He was aware, distantly, of a cold scoff from Stan drifting back toward him on the breeze.
He could only watch as Stan rode Sarah away...

And painfully so, the position of Stan and Sarah was achingly intimate. Sarah clung to Stan from behind, arms wrapped warmly around his waist, her body molded flush against his back. Even from Zane’s trailing vantage point, he could picture it perfectly. Sarah’s large, soft, squishy breasts pressed gently into Stan’s spine with every sway of the bike.

From his angle, he couldn’t see much, but his imagination filled in the rest, Sarah pressed warmly against Stan’s back, close and comfortable in a way she had never been with him, not even for a second.
His teeth ground together.
’What do they all see in him?’
In terms of looks, Zane genuinely did not believe he fell short.
If anything, he had more going for him, the face, the car, the money. By every metric that had ever mattered in his life, he should have been winning.

What he couldn’t see, what he had no way of knowing, was that Stan had already quietly spent millions on both of them, that behind that unassuming, bicycle-riding exterior was someone playing an entirely different game at an entirely different scale.
All Zane had was the scoreboard in front of him.
And it was not going in his favor.
’It should’ve been me.’

chapters.title: Chapter 9: A Legitimate Excuse
paragraphs: ’It should’ve been me.’ Zane was still wishing he were the one in Stan’s Shoe while across town at the Sweet Peach Hotel, Stan and Sarah were already seated in a quiet corner of the restaurant.
The food had arrived, steam curling off delicate porcelain plates, the kind of presentation that belonged on a magazine cover, but Sarah hadn’t touched a single bite.
Her gaze was fixed entirely on him.
Those soft, watery eyes held a kind of quiet intensity that made Stan’s pulse quicken in spite of himself.
She really did live up to her reputation as Peak University’s campus belle. A look alone almost made him lose his composure.
Her face was flawless in the warm restaurant light, delicate features, porcelain skin, lips full and red and slightly parted, the kind that looked soft enough to bruise.
For half a second, Stan caught himself imagining what it would feel like to lean across the table and kiss her. The urge to do that was crazy, but he held himself, after all there was no rush.
He blinked the thought away.
"Stan..." Sarah said softly, her voice barely above a whisper. "The money you lent me, I’ll pay it back. Slowly, but I’ll pay it all back. I promise."
"Don’t mention money," Stan said quickly, forcing a casual smile. "It makes us sound like strangers."
What he really meant was, please, for the love of everything, don’t actually send it back.
The thought of that billion-dollar penalty still haunted him. The system had been terrifyingly clear about the consequences, and terrifyingly silent about the edge cases.
’Surely,’ he reasoned, ’if she sends it back without me asking, against my explicit wishes, the system would have to take that into account. Right? Otherwise the rule makes no sense.’
The system offered no reply.
Which meant he wasn’t about to test it.
Sarah, meanwhile, was quietly melting.
Ten million dollars. No promissory note. No contract. No pressure to repay. And now here he was, brushing off the whole thing like it was pocket change between friends.
Who does that?
He was just too generous.

She found her eyes drifting over his face without meaning to, the sharp line of his jaw, the calm set of his mouth, the easy confidence in the way he held himself. When had he started looking this handsome?
Something warm stirred in her chest, unbidden.
[Sarah: Favorability 30]
[Sarah: Favorability 35]
[Sarah: Favorability 40]
[Sarah: Favorability 45]
Stan caught the rising numbers out of the corner of his eye and almost smiled.
’So she likes hearing this kind of thing.’
He leaned in slightly, voice steady. "I mean it, Sarah. If you’re ever in trouble, forget ten million. I’d lend you twenty without blinking."
[Sarah: Favorability 47]
’Almost there.’ He could feel the threshold coming.
He held her gaze, softening his tone into something more earnest. "I don’t have much in this world. But whatever I do have, if you need it, it’s yours. I don’t care how much it costs."
[Sarah: Favorability 60.]
[Favorability has exceeded 50. The next expenditure will receive a 5x rebate.]
Stan’s breath caught for half a second. Five times.
Across the table, Sarah’s cheeks had gone pink. Feeling a bit bashful, she lowered her gaze, suddenly finding it difficult to look at him directly.

’He’s saying all of this while looking at me like that,’ she thought, heart thudding against her ribs. ’After everything he’s already done, the ten million, no questions asked, no strings attached...’
’Is he in love with me?’
It had to be that. There was only one explanation that made sense. He had to be in love with her.

No one gave away that kind of money for any other reason. Ten million dollars isn’t something one can give out from pure generosity, at least that’s what she thought. It was a confession written in a language only the rich could afford to speak.
And she was starting to think she might be ready to hear it.
Stan wasn’t listening to Sarah’s racing thoughts. He wasn’t thinking about her blush, or her lips, or the way her eyes had softened across the table.
He was thinking about one thing, how to spend money on her.

A five-times rebate was not an opportunity he could afford to miss. And it couldn’t be a small amount, either, half-measures would be a waste of the multiplier. It needed to be a large sum. A significant sum.
But it had to make sense.

Simply shoving another ten million at her across the dinner table for no reason wouldn’t work. Random generosity had a way of reading as desperation, and desperation didn’t raise favorability, it lowered it. Women noticed when things didn’t add up.
He needed a legitimate excuse. A reason that made everything feel natural. Something she couldn’t refuse.
He was still turning the problem over in his head when the restaurant doors opened.
Outside in the lot, a small cluster of men in black leather jackets and dark sunglasses had been standing beside a row of matte-black cars, speaking in low voices.
They had been watching the table through the glass for several minutes. Whatever they were discussing came to an end, one of them straightened his collar, nodded to the others, and walked inside.
He crossed the restaurant without hesitation and stopped directly beside Sarah and Stan’s table.
"Sarah." His voice was cold and clipped. "When is your family planning to pay back the thirty million they owe?"
Sarah’s expression locked. Her chopsticks froze mid-air.
"I’ve already paid back nine million," she said tightly, forcing her voice to stay level. "Give me some time. I’ll find a way."
She couldn’t believe it. The Wilson family’s collectors had gotten bold enough to confront her in public, in the middle of a restaurant, in front of someone else. It was a deliberate humiliation.
Her family’s situation was already a disaster. After the bankruptcy, they had been left owing thirty-nine million dollars to the Wilsons.

The ten million Stan had lent her the day before had bought her breathing room, nine million toward the debt, the last million set aside for her father’s hospital bills. Beyond that, there was nothing. Not a single dollar in reserve.
And then, through the glass doors, she caught sight of a second figure standing quietly just outside, hands in his pockets, watching.
Her stomach dropped. ’Liam.’
The pieces clicked into place with sickening speed. ’He’s with the Wilson family.’
